name: Touch Bar
author: Tim Thomas
description: Karaoke lyrics, a live music visualiser and a full macOS-style Touch Bar for Apple Touch Bar MacBooks running Linux. Time-synced lyrics from LRCLIB for Spotify, YouTube Music, YouTube and any MPRIS player; a real-audio equaliser/equalizer spectrum visualizer coloured from the artwork; volume and brightness sliders, media controls, weather, function keys (F1-F12) and a Touch ID fingerprint prompt. Themed to Omarchy and Hyprland. Also known as touchbard. Intel T2 and Apple Silicon MacBook Pro.

barWidget.description: Touch Bar status: left-click for settings (or to install), right-click toggles the equaliser, middle-click restarts it
